questions.q: On a 1:25 000 map, 8 cm represents what real distance?
questions.why: 1 cm = 250 m, so 8 cm = 2000 m = 2 km.

questions.q: What do closely spaced contour lines show?
questions.why: Contours close together mean height changes quickly: a steep slope.

questions.q: In a grid reference, which comes first?
questions.why: Along the corridor (easting) then up the stairs (northing).

questions.q: Describe how a float can be used to measure river velocity, and give one source of error.
questions.model: Time a float over a measured distance (e.g. 10 m), repeat several times, and divide distance by mean time. Errors include wind blowing the float or timing mistakes.
points: timed over a measured distance, repeated, speed = distance ÷ time
